summary: Mobile View: Core OK / Not OK Buttons Not Visible for Technicians
reported_issue: In the mobile viewport, technicians cannot mark a picked core part as OK or Not OK because those buttons do not appear (they work on desktop). Repro: log in on mobile as a Technician, open a WO, request a part with a core, pick the part, observe the picked part options.
expected_after_fix: The mobile UI should display the OK / Not OK options for a picked core the same way desktop does.
steps_i_followed: Reviewed the part/core-return workflow via API (list-return-requests, is_based_on_core_charge) and the WO Parts sub-tab on desktop and mobile (390x844 emulation).
Searched existing WOs for a core part in the 'picked / awaiting OK-Not OK inspection' state.
Attempted to construct the state (WO/part creation) to expose the OK/Not OK controls.
actual_now: Could not exercise the OK/Not OK controls: existing WO cores on staging were already resolved (status 'Returned'), and no core part was found in the 'picked, awaiting OK/Not OK inspection' state. The specific precondition (request part with a core -> pick it -> core awaiting inspection) could not be constructed within the harness (WO/part create endpoints intermittently 500; no existing record in the needed state), so the OK/Not OK buttons could not be located even on desktop to establish a baseline for the mobile comparison. Note: general mobile WO parts rendering works (verified separately in SV-5128), so the mobile viewport itself is functional.
notes: Blocker is the specific core-inspection data state, not the mobile viewport. To close out: set up a WO with a part that has a core, progress it to picked/awaiting-inspection, then compare the OK/Not OK control visibility on desktop vs 390px mobile as a Technician. Tech Technician role was used during investigation and restored to Time Clock.
